title: A focused run's credit is refused because a write under the worktree's .claude directory (agent tool state, not source) counted as a possible source change
outcome: Writes to agent-tool state directories inside a worktree (such as .claude/) no longer refuse a test run's credit, while real source changes still do; or, if .claude can hold source-relevant files, the refusal names what was written.
acceptance: A focused run's credit is refused because a write under the worktree's .claude directory (agent tool state, not source) counted as a possible source change is done
